verdict.rationale: Mem0 exposes a full REST/OpenAPI surface (mem0-probe-2), an official CLI (mem0-docs-14/34), and an MCP server (mem0-docs-2/18) covering the same core operations shown in the dashboard — add, search, graph memory, entity scoping, export, webhooks, expiration — all documented as API-level features rather than UI-exclusive ones. The self-hosted bundle explicitly ships REST API and dashboard together with parity in API keys and audit logs (mem0-docs-5/28/36). Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement guaranteeing 1:1 UI/API parity, and independent hands-on confirmation that no dashboard-only settings exist (community note mem0-comm-7 shows some playground-specific UX quirks around user switching, suggesting minor UI-side nuance not fully mirrored in docs).
